versions.subject: New Rules: transformed elastic to sigma rules
fix: fixed rules after failed Sigma Rule Tests
fix: fixed rules after review
versions.detection:
selection_name:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\Cmd.Exe'
        - '\PowerShell.EXE'
    - OriginalFilename:
        - '\Cmd.Exe'
        - '\PowerShell.EXE'
selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'echo'
        - '>'
        - '\\\\.\\pipe\\'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\Cmd.Exe", "*\\PowerShell.EXE") OR OriginalFilename IN ("\\Cmd.Exe", "\\PowerShell.EXE") CommandLine="*echo*" CommandLine="*>*" CommandLine="*\\\\.\\pipe\\*"
